items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: Interviewer mentions 'Amelia was there with Telfer then' and asks 'You saw him the first night you were in town?' Interviewee responds 'No, no, no, no...'

ctx.x: Which I can't play there now if I want. Man, if I was going to tell them I want to play here, I'm sorry for the band there. Got to go.

I think when I first came there, I came down here for the Sugar Bowl game the University of Georgia was playing here. What year? Well, I can look that up, but I don't know, 47 I think. Anyway, I can date it by that. I remember the game. And Amelia was there with Telfer then. You saw him the first night you were in town? No, no, no, no, first- Second- and dated by that, I remember the game. And Mealy was there with Telfer then.
You saw him the first night you were in town?
